leads.title: Zephaniah's Day of YHWH against Judah ↔ Al-Lat, al-'Uzza and Manat; angelic intercession; the scrolls of Abraham and Moses; the Lord of Sirius
leads.summary: 1 correspondence read side by side: 1 same element.

evidence.text: Read side by side in both originals (alignments/hb-quran/07-hb-quran.yaml).
Shared motifs, rarest first: 'The imminent (al-azifa) has drawn near'; none but God can remove it (weight 6.7). Pair score 6.7.

Only in Zephaniah's Day of YHWH against Judah: Men thickened on their lees who say in their hearts 'YHWH will do neither good nor evil'; The Day of YHWH is a sacrifice he has prepared, with invited guests consecrated; Litany of the Day: day of wrath, distress, ruin, darkness, cloud and thick darkness, shofar and alarm; God will search Jerusalem with lamps to find the complacent; Named districts of Jerusalem (Fish Gate, Mishneh/Second Quarter, Maktesh/Mortar) wail; A prophet's genealogy is traced several generations back to a king (Hezekiah); God will punish officials and princes who wear foreign garments; People bow and swear both by YHWH and by Malkam (their king or Milcom); God will sweep away humans, beasts, birds of the air and fish of the sea from the face of the ground (creation reversed); Idolatrous priests (kemarim) who burned incense to Baal, sun, moon, constellations are put down; Priests do not tread on a temple threshold, explained by an event; 'Hush (has) before YHWH, all the earth', for he is in his holy temple or has roused himself; and 7 more.

Only in Al-Lat, al-'Uzza and Manat; angelic intercession; the scrolls of Abraham and Moses; the Lord of Sirius: The three goddesses al-Lat, al-'Uzza and Manat, 'the third, the other', named and rejected; They follow only conjecture (zann), and conjecture avails nothing against the truth; God created the pairs, male and female, from a drop of sperm (nutfa) when it is emitted; A surah ends with the command to prostrate (sajda verse); God destroyed 'Ad 'the first' (implying a second 'Ad); God knew you when he produced you from the earth and when you were embryos in your mothers' bellies; do not claim purity; The idols are only names you and your fathers have named, for which God sent down no authority; God is 'the Lord of Sirius' (al-shi'ra), a star worshipped by some Arabs; Those who avoid the great sins and indecencies, except minor slips (al-lamam), find God's forgiveness wide; To your Lord is the final end (al-muntaha); 'Is the male for you and the female for him? That is an unfair division'; 'Which of your Lord's bounties (ala') will you dispute/deny?'; and 15 more.
